title: Evaluation as a sum of path indicators
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $T$ be a real-output decision tree whose queries are restricted to a set $I$ of the $n$ coordinates. For every input $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, the value of $T$ at $x$ equals the sum over its paths $P$ of $P$'s output multiplied by the indicator that $x$ matches the coordinate values specified by $P$.
hypotheses_covered: real-output decision tree T indexed by I
